rows.label: qst104221_msg0001
rows.name:
Oh, Toatoa is energetically
researching today as well, mo.

rows.label: qst104221_msg0002
rows.name:
I examine the things I salvage. If
they're old, I think about what they
were for and why they were made...

rows.label: qst104221_msg0003
rows.name:
Thinking about the history of things
keeps me awake, mo. It's romantic, mo.

rows.label: qst104221_msg0004
rows.name:
I've traveled to many countries and
salvaged things, but...

rows.label: qst104221_msg0005
rows.name:
I want to meet someone who'll listen
seriously to this romance, mo...

rows.label: qst104221_msg0006
rows.name:
A teacher in Iyasaki Village?
Toatoa will be teaching, mo?

rows.label: qst104221_msg0007
rows.name:
I'm good at history, mo! But I know
nothing at all about anything else!

rows.label: qst104221_msg0008
rows.name:
Wait, mo! Before I become a teacher,
there's something I want to get, mo.

rows.label: qst104221_msg0009
rows.name:
The Old Salvaging Suit... I don't
even know where to get one, mo. If
you find one, I'll go, mo.

rows.label: qst104221_msg0051
rows.name: Really invite Toatoa to be a teacher?

rows.label: qst104221_msg0052
rows.name: Invite

rows.label: qst104221_msg0053
rows.name: Think it over

rows.label: qst104221_msg0061
rows.name:
Will you help me, mo?
I'm so happy, mo.

rows.label: qst104221_msg0062
rows.name:
Just one Old Salvaging Suit is
enough, mo. Bring it to me, mo.

rows.label: qst104221_msg0063
rows.name:
Toatoa doesn't know where
to get it, though...mo...

rows.label: qst104221_msg0081
rows.name:
Got it, mo. I'll find the Old
Salvaging Suit myself, mo.

rows.label: qst104221_msg0101
rows.name: Is the teaching offer still open, mo?

rows.label: qst104221_msg0121
rows.name:
Could it be somewhere people don't
normally go, mo?

rows.label: qst104221_msg0122
rows.name:
Could Rex and the others be salvaging
somewhere in the Cloud Sea, mo...?

rows.label: qst104221_msg0123
rows.name:
There are so many unknowns,
mo. Patience is a virtue, mo.

rows.label: qst104221_msg0151
rows.name:
The Old Salvaging Suit!!
Th-This is... so big, mo!

rows.label: qst104221_msg0152
rows.name:
Wearing something like this
would make it hard to move and
difficult to salvage, mo.

rows.label: qst104221_msg0153
rows.name:
...But there must be a
reason for this size, mo!

rows.label: qst104221_msg0154
rows.name:
When I get to Iyasaki Village, I'll
research the history of the Old
Salvaging Suit, mo!

rows.label: qst104221_msg0155
rows.name: And I'll teach on the side, mo!

rows.label: qst104221_msg0156
rows.name:
Well then, once I've packed my
salvaging tools, I'll head to
Iyasaki Village, mo~

rows.label: qst104221_msg0201
rows.name:
Have you found a teacher, mo?
That's good, mo.

rows.label: qst104221_msg0301
rows.name:
But it's rare to meet such
a person... Harder than
finding treasure, mo.
